note: Supports exactly three releases: 0.2.1-rc.2 (the default host) and the earlier 0.1.5-rc.3 and 0.1.7-rc.1. `channels` lists the npm dist-tags of the Harness CLI package @deepseek-ai/dsh that name the release: on 2026-10-21 latest and next both name 0.2.1-rc.2, and 0.1.5-rc.3 (formerly latest) and 0.1.7-rc.1 (formerly next) carry none. Round 28 (2026-09-24) dropped 0.1.2-rc.1, 0.1.3-alpha.2, 0.1.5-rc.1 and 0.1.6-alpha.2. See docs/validation.md for the gates run against checkouts built from the release tags; a matching version string alone does not establish compatibility with another checkout.
